dac~.description: One signal inlet per channel argument. Default (no args): 2 inlets.

unpack.description: Number of arguments determines number of outlets; bare unpack keeps the default 2 outlets.

switch.description: First argument + 1 sets number of inlets (control inlet + N data inlets). Bare switch = 3 inlets.

spray.description: First argument sets number of outlets.

funnel.description: First argument sets number of inlets.

join.description: First argument sets number of inlets.

expr~.description: Inlet count equals the number of distinct $fN/$iN variables in the expression. Default 1 signal inlet.

codebox.description: Inlet/outlet count is determined by `in N`/`out N` declarations in the codebox body, not by arguments. Default 1/1.

codebox~.description: Signal inlet/outlet count is determined by `in N`/`out N` declarations in the codebox~ body, not by arguments. Default 1/1.

pan~.description: Fixed mono -> stereo signal pan: 2 signal inlets, 2 signal outlets.

bpatcher.description: Inlet/outlet count matches the inlet and outlet objects inside the loaded subpatch. Cannot be computed from arguments; inherit from the referenced .maxpat file at load time.

cycle.description: Round-robin router: first arg sets number of outlets (messages cycle through outlets 0..N-1). Default: 2 outlets.

combine.description: Number of arguments determines number of inlets (bare combine: 1 inlet); always 2 outlets (combined symbol, then the done outlet).

router.description: Variable routing matrix: first arg = inlets, second arg = outlets. Default: 2x2.

mc.combine~.description: mc.combine~ number-of-inlets: first arg sets inlet count. Default 2 inlets. Output is a single multichannel signal that concatenates all channels from inputs.

_audit.finding: Unlike core 'combine' (arg_count over list args), mc.combine~ takes one optional int for inlet count. Default 2 per docs.

mc.deinterleave~.description: mc.deinterleave~ outputs: first arg sets outlet count. Default 2 outlets.

_audit.finding: Single int 'outputs' arg. Default 2 inferred from DB entry (no refpage default stated).

mc.fffb~.description: mc.fffb~ number-of-filters: first arg sets signal outlet count (one per filter). When instantiated as 'mcs.fffb~' this behavior collapses into a single MC outlet — the mcs variant is a different object. Default 4 outlets (matches DB entry).

_audit.finding: Refpage: 'mcs.fffb~ has a single multichannel output; otherwise it has a separate outlet for each filter.' This rule is for mc.fffb~ (separate outlets); mcs variants are separate objects in the DB if they exist.

mc.gate~.description: mc.gate~ number-of-outlets: first arg sets outlet count. Default 1 outlet. Mirrors core 'gate' rule (inlet_count:fixed:2 is the signal-domain pattern from gate — control route inlet + signal inlet).

_audit.finding: Same arg semantics as MSP gate~ / core gate. Note: DB entry shows 2 inlets (signal+route), which matches fixed:2.

mc.interleave~.description: mc.interleave~ inputs: first arg sets inlet count. Default 2 inlets.

_audit.finding: Single int 'inputs' arg; default 2 per refpage.

mc.matrix~.description: mc.matrix~ N M: first arg = signal inlets, second = signal outlets; M audio outlets + 2 control outlets (list dump, then a further control outlet). Default 2x2 = 4 outlets. trailing_outlets 2: with args, the last two outlets are the DB's last two and every earlier outlet repeats DB outlet 0 (audio).

_audit.source: Q2 / A1 (261012-c5i, OQ2-A): MAX-saved help boxes `mc.matrix~ 3 2` = 3/4 and `mc.matrix~ 4 2` = 4/4, outlettype [multichannelsignal, multichannelsignal, "", ""]; the 9.2 refpage lists only 3 outlets (2x2 template). Supersedes quick-260421-bx3 (DQ-07), which excluded the dump outlet.

mc.pack~.description: mc.pack~ size: argument sets both inlet count and output channel count. Default 2 inlets. Output is a single multichannel signal outlet.

_audit.finding: Argument-driven inlet count. Distinct from core 'pack' (arg_count over typespec list); mc.pack~ takes a single int 'size'.

mc.selector~.description: mc.selector~ number-of-inputs: first arg + 1 sets inlet count (N inputs plus a selector inlet at left). Default 2 inlets.

_audit.finding: Identical semantics to selector~ (rule already in overrides.json).

mc.separate~.description: mc.separate~ channels-per-outlet: each argument creates one outlet whose MC signal has the specified channel count. Default 2 outlets.

_audit.finding: Argument list drives outlet count (mirrors core 'pack' arg_count pattern). Refpage: 'Each argument creates an outlet whose output multichannel signal will contain the number of channels specified by that argument.'

mc.unpack~.description: mc.unpack~ size: argument sets single-channel outlet count. Default 2 outlets. Input is a single multichannel signal inlet.

_audit.finding: Argument-driven outlet count. Distinct from core 'unpack' (arg_count over typespec list); mc.unpack~ takes a single int 'size'.

pak.description: Like pack: number of arguments determines number of inlets (all hot); bare pak keeps the default 2 inlets.

sfplay~.description: sfplay~ [sflist] N [bufsize] [posflag]: N signal outlets + posflag (0-2) position signal outlets + 1 bang outlet (when done). A leading symbol (sflist~ name) is skipped (Ambire v0.14.0: sfplay~ sf.cues 2 0 1 = 4 outlets, per refpage objarglist). trailing_outlets 1: with args, the LAST outlet is the DB's last (the done-bang) and every earlier outlet repeats DB outlet 0 (audio).

play~.description: play~ buf N: N signal outlets + 1 bang outlet (playback reached its destination or stopped). gate~.description: gate~ N: 2 inlets (control, signal), N signal outlets; bare gate~ = 1 outlet.

bucket.description: bucket N: N outlets (bucket brigade); bare bucket = 1 outlet (refpage: "no argument: one outlet").

buddy.description: buddy N: N inlets and N outlets; bare buddy = 2 and 2 (refpage: "no argument: two inlets and two outlets").

bangbang.description: bangbang / b N: N outlets; bare = 2 outlets.

groove~.description: groove~ buf N: N signal outlets + the sync outlet; fewer than 2 args = 1 channel + sync. trailing_outlets 1: the last outlet is the DB's sync outlet, earlier outlets repeat DB outlet 0.

tapout~.description: tapout~: one delay-time inlet and one signal outlet per tap argument; bare = 1 tap.

record~.description: record~ buf N: N signal inlets + start and end point inlets; fewer than 2 args = 1 channel (3 inlets). trailing_inlets 2: with args, the LAST two inlets are the DB's last two (start / end) and every earlier inlet repeats DB inlet 0 (signal).

jit.pack.description: jit.pack N: N matrix inlets (planes), 2 outlets (matrix, dump); bare = 4 inlets.

jit.unpack.description: jit.unpack N: N matrix outlets + the dump outlet; bare = 4 + dump. trailing_outlets 1: the last outlet is the DB's dump outlet.

mc.route.description: mc.route N: 2 inlets, N outlets; bare = 2 outlets. Outlet signal roles are Q11 (C9) scope.

sfrecord~.description: sfrecord~ N: one signal inlet per input channel (inlet 0 also takes the open/record messages); no arg = 1 channel. trailing_inlets 0: every inlet repeats DB inlet 0.
